The '''Skyblade-330''' was a model of [[swoop]] bike manufactured by [[Caelli-Merced]]. A modified Skyblade-330<ref name="Topps" /> was notably used by [[Enfys Nest]].<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> [[Rekias Nodo]] also possessed one such bike.<ref name="Choose Your Destiny" />

==Description==
[[File:Skyblade330Swoop-SaS.png|thumb|left|220px|A rider on a Skyblade-330 spots a [[K79-S80 Imperial Troop Transport]] from above.]]
The Skyblade-330 was similar to other Skyblade models used by the Cloud-Riders, such as the [[Halberd-441|Arrogantus-X Skyblade-221 swoop bike]], which had a side car for a passenger or gunner.<ref name="Solo Guide" />

Enfys Nest's modified Skyblade-330 had a blaster cannon situated between the three steering vanes, situated at the end of a long outrigger attached to the main body of the vehicle. The maneuver controls connected to the outright by long, thin rods. Behind the pilot seat and above the repulsorlift engine was a single vertical rear wing. The pilot's feet rested on attitude control pedals. The main power cell was located beneath the maneuver controls at the base of the outrigger.<ref name="Topps" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Skyblade_330_swoop.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Concept art of a Skyblade-330]]
The Skyblade first appeared in the book ''[[Choose Your Destiny: A Han & Chewie Adventure]]'' before showing up onscreen in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.

[[Lucasfilm]] built a full-size practical speeder, using airplane parts for the "greebles." CGI was used to show the speeders in flight. It also used the same engine as the [[M-68 landspeeder]].<ref name="Train Heist">"[[The Train Heist]]" BluRay featurette</ref>
